e.title: Parametric Payout Assurance Standard
e.summary: 参数险赔付保障开放标准（PPAS）：机器核验参数化气候保险是否按承诺赔付
e.body: Parametric Payout Assurance Standard（PPAS）是开放标准：用机器核验参数化气候保险产品是否真的按承诺向承诺对象赔付——参数险的赔付透明度与问责（参数险自动赔付的『实际兑现』验证）。对 RIAA：参数险治理/赔付验证的标准参考（与 [[parametric-insurance-demo]] 的自动化理赔互补）。关联 [[insurance-governance]]、[[fair-pricing-playbook]]、[[actuarial-pricing]]、[[reinsurance]]。
e.verified_note: raw README 核实：PPAS 开放标准（机器核验参数险按承诺赔付）
e.summary_en: Open standard for machine-checking whether a parametric climate-insurance product actually paid what it promised (PPAS)
e.summary_hk: 參數險賠付保障開放標準（PPAS）：機器核驗參數化氣候保險是否按承諾賠付
e.body_en: The Parametric Payout Assurance Standard (PPAS) is an open standard for machine-checking whether a parametric climate-insurance product actually paid what it promised to the people it promised — payout transparency and accountability for parametric insurance (verifying the 'actual fulfilment' of automatic parametric payouts). For RIAA: the standard reference for parametric-insurance governance/payout verification (complementing [[parametric-insurance-demo]]'s automated claims). Related: [[insurance-governance]], [[fair-pricing-playbook]], [[actuarial-pricing]], [[reinsurance]].
e.body_hk: Parametric Payout Assurance Standard（PPAS）是開放標準：用機器核驗參數化氣候保險產品是否真的按承諾向承諾對象賠付——參數險的賠付透明度與問責（參數險自動賠付的『實際兌現』驗證）。對 RIAA：參數險治理/賠付驗證的標準參考（與 [[parametric-insurance-demo]] 的自動化理賠互補）。關聯 [[insurance-governance]]、[[fair-pricing-playbook]]、[[actuarial-pricing]]、[[reinsurance]]。
